claim_summary: Seventeen commercial spirulina supplements contained 128 identified VOCs by HS-SPME-GC-MS. The largest classes were alkanes, ketones, aldehydes and alcohols. The figures are relative areas, not concentrations, and they vary by product.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Beta-ionone was reported in all 17 spirulina supplements, at 7.0 to 21.1 percent of identified VOC area, with the odor word floral. That range is not an odor-activity value.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Hexanal was reported in all 17 spirulina supplements, at 1.2 to 8.7 percent of identified VOC area, with the odor words green and grassy.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Beta-cyclocitral was reported in all 17 spirulina supplements, at 1.2 to 4.2 percent of identified VOC area, with the odor word minty.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: 1-Octen-3-ol was reported in all 17 spirulina supplements, at 2.2 to 8.6 percent of identified VOC area, with the odor word mushroom-like.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Heptadecane was the most abundant hydrocarbon in the spirulina supplements, at 10.5 to 48.7 percent of identified VOC area. The table's odor word is alkane. A large relative area is not evidence that it drives an off-note.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: GC-O of one spirulina supplement suspension rated 2-ethyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine at FD 2048 and beta-ionone and acetic acid at FD 1024. These are dilution ranks for that suspension, not concentrations and not a protein-bar result.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Static headspace above the spirulina supplement suspension detected methanethiol, sulfuric and cabbage-like, at an FD factor of at least 32.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: GC-O identified geosmin in the spirulina supplement suspension at FD factor 64, with odor words musty, earthy and beetroot. That factor is not a concentration. 2-methylisoborneol was not in the odorant table.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: In a phototrophic Chlorella vulgaris culture, hexanal was 20.21 percent of relative VOC area, with table descriptors grass, tallow and fat. That is not a dried-powder concentration and not a bar result.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: The same culture table reports oct-3-en-2-ol at 9.41 percent and 1-octen-3-ol at 6.63 percent of relative area, both with a mushroom descriptor.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: 2,4-Decadienal is listed at 0.13 percent of relative area in the chlorella culture, with the descriptor seaweed. The isomer is not specified, so this is a weak association.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: A second study reports Chlorella vulgaris volatiles as percent of normalized TIC area, including hexanal at 4.40 percent and beta-ionone at 0.49 percent. Those means must not be averaged with the 2021 culture percentages.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: A detected peak and an odor word in a GC-MS table do not show that the compound causes that note in a protein bar. None of the analytical rows in this extract were measured in the project's oat and date matrix.
source_location: Scope of Foods 2024 versus a protein bar
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: A snack-bar abstract reports spirulina addition at 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 percent, with no significant sensory difference in that study and a slightly-liked score at 5 percent. This is acceptance of a snack bar, not a measured drop in a named off-note.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Gluten-free biscuits were made with spirulina at 0, 0.5, 1 and 5 percent of the rice flour. The 0.5 percent flour replacement was most preferred, and higher rates lowered sensory scores. Those percentages are not the share of the whole biscuit.
source_location: Abstract and methods: rates of rice flour
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: This extract does not contain a trial showing that cocoa, cinnamon, vanilla or citrus reduces a named algae off-note in a protein bar. Those ingredient forms are search-space candidates only.
source_location: Absence noted against the formulation candidate list
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: USDA spirulina and other ingredient rows are generic FoodData Central foods. They are not the composition of the 17 supplements, the AEDA product, or a chosen supplier lot. An empty nutrient is unknown, not zero.
source_location: FDC food records cited on each nutrition row
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Milk, soy, peanut, almond and sesame contains-links are identity matches to the FDA major-allergen list. They are not assays of a lot. Coconut oil is not linked as a tree nut under the 2025 FAQ used here. No ingredient is marked free-from.
source_location: FDA major-allergen list and 2025 coconut FAQ
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: The stored 0 to 5 percent spirulina bound is the snack-bar abstract's tested range. It is not a safety or regulatory maximum, and it was not confirmed as finished-bar percent weight from the full paper.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: The dried-date nutrition row must not be used as date paste. The plan forbids combining nutrients across ingredient forms without an explicit transformation, and none is recorded.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.

claim_summary: Chlorella observations come from two materials: a 2021 phototrophic culture and a 2024 biomass profile. A formulator should not treat either profile as the sensory identity of an unnamed commercial powder.
notes: PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. Not approved. Reviewer-written note. No paper text is stored.
